init_wandb_singleton: initialize a WandBSingletonLogger instance with config, run_id, run_name, log_dir, project, and entity
log_with_wandb_singleton: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the WandBSingletonLogger singleton instance
log_table_wandb: log a wandb Table with column names and row data using the WandBSingletonLogger
log_dataframe_wandb: log a pandas DataFrame as a wandb Table using the WandBSingletonLogger singleton
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics like mean, std, min, max to wandb using the log_stats convenience function
